I've never once pumped my own gas. Kind of curious to the process, actually.

It's really simple:

Swipe your card, and hit the button to select your octane level (gas type). Take your gas cap off (set it somewhere you won't lose it), lift the nozzle from the pump, old-timey pumps used to make you lit the "saddle" the nozzle was hanging in but newer ones don't do that any more, and put the nozzle in your gas tank. Squeeze the lever, which is built into the handle of the nozzle, and watch the price skyrocket. There's a little "flap" in the nozzle handle to "lock" it in the "pour" position, so you don't have to stand there and hold it the whole time... don't worry, it'll automatically pop "off" when you're full, unless it's broken, which has happened to me once.

you're all full, make sure the nozzle is "off," remove it from your tank, push that saddle back down (if you had to lift it), put the nozzle into the saddle, put your gas cap back, get your receipt, and go home.

If you ever end up with a fire (for some ungodly reason), NEVER pull the nozzle from your gas tank. Leave that shit in there, and look for the emergency shut-off button. It's usually on the side of the building, and it'll stop the gas flow to all pumps.
